name: metricx
description: Query MetricX call center data: calls, service KPIs, AI-generated quality scores and call transcripts. Read-only and limited to the permissions of your MetricX user.

interface.longDescription:
MetricX is a call center analytics platform. This plugin lets supervisors and managers of companies that use MetricX ask about their own telephony data in plain language or SQL: inbound, outbound and missed calls, service KPIs (answer rate, wait and talk times) by department, extension or hour, AI-generated quality scores with their reasons, and call transcripts, including keyword search across transcripts.

Who it is for: MetricX customers (Admin and Supervisor roles) whose company administrator has enabled the MCP agent for their user. Sign-in uses the same MetricX e-mail and password (OAuth 2.1).

Limitations: read-only (no tool changes data); each user sees only their company, or the extensions of their departments; data is refreshed every ~5 minutes; queries return at most 1,000 rows and are rate-limited per user. The data and interface are in Brazilian Portuguese.
defaultPrompt: How many calls did we receive this week, by department?
Which agents had the lowest quality scores this month, and why?
Find calls in the last 30 days where the customer mentioned canceling.

positive.description: Service KPIs for a period, grouped by department
positive.prompt: Show me the call center KPIs for the last 7 days by department: total, answered and missed calls and average wait time.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls obter_indicadores with agrupar_por=departamento and returns a per-department table with totals, answered/missed calls and average wait time, stating when the data was last refreshed.

positive.prompt: List the 10 most recent missed inbound calls.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls listar_chamadas filtered by inbound type and missed status with limite=10, and lists date/time, department and extension of each call, with masked phone numbers.

positive.prompt: Pick the most recent call that has a transcript, show its details and its transcript.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a call with somente_com_transcricao=true, then shows its metadata and AI quality analysis (detalhar_chamada) and the turn-by-turn transcript with speakers and timestamps (obter_transcricao).

positive.prompt: In the last 30 days, find calls where the customer talked about canceling (search for "cancelar").
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_nas_transcricoes with termo=cancelar and falante=cliente, and returns matching excerpts with the call id and date.

positive.description: Free-form analytical question answered with SQL
positive.prompt: What was the average quality score per department in the last 30 days? Show the SQL you used.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls perguntar_metricx (or descrever_dados followed by consultar_sql) and returns the average score per department together with the read-only SQL that was executed.

negative.description: Attempt to modify or delete data
negative.prompt: Delete all calls from yesterday and reset the quality scores of the support department.

negative.description: Attempt to access another company's data
negative.prompt: Show me the calls of another company that uses MetricX, not mine.
Book a flight to São Paulo for next Monday.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to MetricX calls, service KPIs, AI quality scores and transcripts, with OAuth sign-in.

pt-BR.subtitle: Métricas de call center
pt-BR.description:
Consulte os dados de telefonia do MetricX em linguagem natural ou SQL: chamadas recebidas, realizadas e perdidas, indicadores de atendimento (taxa de atendimento, tempo de espera e de conversa) por departamento, ramal ou hora, notas de qualidade geradas por IA com os motivos e transcrições das chamadas, com busca por palavra-chave.

Para clientes do MetricX (cargos Administrador e Supervisor) com o Agente MCP liberado pelo administrador da empresa. O login usa o mesmo e-mail e senha do MetricX (OAuth 2.1).

Limitações: somente leitura; cada usuário vê apenas a própria empresa ou os ramais dos seus departamentos; dados atualizados a cada ~5 minutos; até 1.000 linhas por consulta e limites de uso por usuário.
